pn-98o5.title: Coverage: only two islands
pn-98o5.summary: Coverage covers two islands, but one has just a little beach coverage. The clues here focus on the main island.

pn-NJg9.title: Landscape: very red soil
pn-NJg9.summary: The soil is often very red.

pn-No2U.title: Coverage: Gen 3 trekker
pn-No2U.summary: All coverage is the older Gen 3 trekker, carried on foot (blurrier, softer colours).

pn-Vx9G.title: Landscape: dense forest, small dirt tracks
pn-Vx9G.summary: A semi-tropical, densely forested island. Most coverage is on small dirt tracks through the forest.

pn-YjoB.title: Houses: lone village, some concrete roads
pn-YjoB.summary: The island's only settlement is near the northeastern shore. Some of its roads are concrete rather than dirt.

pn-jfvK.title: Coverage: tiny Pacific island group
pn-jfvK.summary: A group of four islands in the South Pacific and a UK territory, so it counts as the UK for streaks.

pn-rcoG.title: Landmark: dock with many small ATVs
pn-rcoG.summary: A dock marked The Landing, full of small ATVs, at the eastern end of the village.

pn-wWlg.title: Landscape: white sand beaches
pn-wWlg.summary: On the second, smaller island, coverage is only two white sand beaches on the northern and eastern shore.
